segments.headline: How Apple's humanoid trained in simulation

beats.narration: Apple's humanoid learned this in a thousand homes that don't exist. How?
No one steered it by hand. Its skills were learned only in simulation.

visual.sub: no teleoperation · trained only in simulation

beats.narration: First, a computer plans its moves: walk forward, turn around, sit on the chair.
Then it places them in one of a thousand generated homes,
and renders what the robot's camera would see. A flight simulator, for a robot.

visual.sub: it renders what the robot's camera would see

beats.narration: An off-the-shelf AI model splits each request into steps: crouch under the table, push the box.
Six real homes it had never seen: ninety-one percent on single tasks, in a preprint.
The catch with longer tasks is in the full episode. Link below.
